title: Pickled Sweet Potatoes
blurb: A quick pickle rather than a canning-jar one — an hour on the counter is enough before these are ready, though a week in the fridge only sharpens them.

ingredients.note: large, peeled, sliced about 1/8 inch thick

steps: Combine the rice vinegar, water, sugar and salt in a large nonreactive saucepan.
Combine the chopped anaheim chiles and red onion in a large heatproof bowl.
Using a mandoline, slice the sweet potatoes about 1/8 inch thick and add them to the vinegar mixture.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 2 minutes.
Pour the hot vinegar mixture over the onion mixture. Let stand 1 hour before serving, or cover and refrigerate up to 1 week.
